sanskrit: evaṃ sañcintayeddevīṃ brahmamārgeṇa gāminīmdaśabhujāṃ mahādevīṃ pītavarṇāṃ sanātanīmdakṣiṇe vibhratīṃ devīṃ kāmabījoparisthitāmdhārayantiṃ mahādevīṃ mahāsiṃhāsanasthitāmbrahmaviṣṇumahādevavanditāṃ surasundarīmsiṃhaskandhasamāruḍhāṃ dvibhujāṃ sumanoharāmjaṭāmukuṭa saṃyuktāmarddhacandravibhūṣitāmraktavastraparīdhānāṃ kamalāpatisevitāmsuṣumnāvartmanā devi cintayeddhyānarūpiṇīmsahasrāre dale caiva cintayet parameśvarīmgaṅgādisarvatīrthañca amṛtaṃ pratipatrakeśvetavarṇaṃ mahādevi sahasradalamuttamamsarvamantramayaṃ devi caturvedavibhūṣitāmkarṇikāṃ svarṇavarṇāñca tatra devīṃ vicintayetsārātsārataraṃ parādapiparaṃ cetovacohagocaramśivaśaktimayaṃ devi nirguṇaṃ saguṇātmakamcaitanyarūpiṇaṃ devaṃ paramāmṛtavṛṃhitamghoradaṃṣṭrāṃ karālāsyāṃ lalajjihvāṃ caturbhujāmabhayaṃ varadañcaiva dakṣiṇādhorddhapāṇikāmkaṇṭhāvaśaktamuṇḍālī galadrudhiracarcitāmvalārkamaṇḍalākāra locanatrayabhūṣitāmmuktakeśīṃ smitamukhīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīmśavarupamahādeva-hṛdayopari saṃsthitāmśivābhirghorarāvābhiścaturdikṣu samanvitāmanāhatantu tatraiva taḍitkoṭisamaprabhām

sanskrit: tayā sahitamātmānamekībhūtam vicintayetsūryakoṭiprabhākyaraṃ candrakoṭisuśītalamgatvā kulākulaṃ divyaṃ punareva viśet kulammūlādhārasaroje tu trikoṇaṃ sumanoharamtadurddhe kuṇḍalīśaktistaḍitkoṭisamaprabhāmsudhādhāratrikoṇe tāṃ bhāvayet surasundarīmindau tadurddhe vodhinyāṃ nāde nādānta eva camantrākṣarāṇi cicchaktauprotāni paricintayetdarśayedātmasadbhāvaṃ pūjahomādikaṃ vināsarvapāpādvinirmukta iṣṭāṃ devīṃ prapaśyatiaṣṭādaśamahāsiddhirvatsarānte bhaviṣyatisa eva śaṅkaraḥ sākṣāt sa eva viṣṇuravyayaḥiti te kathitā devi yonimudrā maheśvariiti kubjikātantre ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ || 0bhāvañca śrotumicchāmi devatāyā viśeṣataḥtatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathyatāṃ prāṇavallabhatava snehāt pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānena sundaripālanaṃ kurute viṣṇū rūdraśca nāśakaḥ punaḥsa eva vandyo lokesmin sa eva puruṣottamaḥviśvañca devatārūpaṃ bhāvayet surasundarihṛdaye pārvatīṃ devīṃ śirasā śivarūpiṇamnityasnānaṃ nityadānaṃ trisandhyañca japārcanamvede śāstre dṛḍhajñānaṃ gurau deve tathaiva cavaiśvadevantathā śrāddhaṃ nityaṃ kāryāṃ śucismiteannañcaiva maheśāni sarveṣāṃ parivarjayet

sanskrit: kadaryañca mahādevi niṣṭhuraṃ parivarjayetsatyañca kathayeddevi na mithyāñca kadācanagurorārādhanaṃ devi pratyahaṃ cintayet sudhīḥekagrāme sthitaṃ nityaṃ trisandhyaṃ praṇamedgurumstrīṇāṃ padatalaṃ dṛṣṭvā guruvadbhāvayet sadāśarīraṃ kārayeddevi gandharvadevamuttamamnityaṃ satvaguṇenaiva pūjayet sūrasundarīmdevatā ca mahādevi nānyosti mama dehaketripuṇḍaṃ bhasmanā vāpi raktacandanakena vākevalaṃ bhairavobhūtvā yajeddevīṃ sanātanīmsamayāñca gṛhītvā tu pūjādau ca maheśvarikulavṛkṣantathā dṛṣṭvā kartavyañca maheśvarirātrau ca pūjayeddevīṃ na divāpi kadācanasarvañcaiva maheśāni paradevesamarpayetrātrau yantrañca mālāñca naspūśettu kadācanamantre cākṣaravuddhiñca aviśvāsogurau sadānirāmiṣeṇa deveśi devatāyāḥ prapūjanamsarveṣāñcaiva nindāñca mantra kūryānmaheśvariuttamodivyabhāvaśca vīrabhāvaśca madhyamaḥpaśubhāve sthitā mantrāḥ kevalā varṇarūpiṇaḥdṛṣṭvā kulaṃ maheśāni kulavṛkṣaṃ viśeṣataḥkūlastriyaṃ mahādevi tantramantraviśāradāmvṛddhāṃ vā yuvatīṃ vāpi namaskūryādvarānanepañcavaryaṃ samārabhya yāvaddvādaśavārṣikīṣaḍvarṣañca samārabhya yāvacca navavārṣikī

sanskrit: āsane ca japenmantraṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamṣaṭsahasraṃ japenmantraṃ vairiṇā homayed dhruvamniśīthe ca maheśāni kṛṣṇapuṣpaṇa homayetkulapuṣpeṇa deveśi homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥaṣṭottarasahasreṇa vairiṇaṃ mohayet dhruvamaṣṭākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ dvisahasraṃ japet sudhīḥgomuṇḍañca samādāya nāmamantraṃ likhettataḥjuhūyānnīlapuṣpeṇa aṣṭottaraśataṃ punaḥsuryodayaṃ samārabhya yāvat sūryāntaraṃ bhavetsandhyākālaṃ samārabhya yāvat suryodayaṃ bhavetkṛṣṇapuṣpeṇa hotavyaṃ yāvaduccāṭanaṃ bhavetmātṛkāpuṭitaṃ kṛtvā prajapet surasundaridaśāhābhyantare vairivināśo jāyate dhruvamyoginīṃ tatra sampūjya bhairavaṃ pūjayettataḥkṣetrapālañca saspūjya tāriṇīṃ tatra pūjayetviṃśatyakṣaramucārya nāmnomadhye sanātanitāvajjapaṃ prakurvīta śatrūṇāṃ nāśanāya cahotavyaṃ tatradeveśi deveśañca yajet sudhīḥkīlakaṃ tatra vaddhvā ca mūlamantrairmaheśvaribhairavaṃ tatra sampujya śavasnānaṃ samācaretvaṭukaṃ kṣetrapālañca yoginīṃ bhairavīntathāyavanīñca vinā devi śavaṃ sañcintayet sudhīḥśavarūpaṃ śivantatra cintayet parameśvarimantrasiddhintathā devi rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatampaṭhitvaivaṃ mahādevi śavapṛṣṭhaṃ samāhitaḥ

sanskrit: karālīntatra sampūjya homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥutakaṭe ca mahādevi kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ kuleśvarinagnaḥ śaktisamāyukto bhutvā tu bhairavottamaḥdakṣiṇekālike devi kāmabījaṃ tataḥ paramgajāntakasahasrantu japaṃ kuryādvarānanesarvakāmārthasiddhiḥ syāt sa eva bhairavottamaḥiti kubjikātantre aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥlakṣaṇaṃ mantrasiddheśca kathyatāṃ bhutabhāvanahṛdayagranthibhedaśca romnaśca harṣaṇantathānityaharṣo nityaśraddhā sarvadā vedabhūṣitamajñānenānusandhānāt paścāt jñānaṃ prapaśyatidevatāpratisandhānāt karuṇoktiḥ prajāyatedivyaṃ jñānaṃ śarīre ca sarvadā devatarpaṇamloṣṭre ca kāñcane caiva samajñānañca paśyatisākārabhāvane devi pūtravat snehamācaretmama dehe ca nānyosti devatā caiva titaṣṭhatitriśuladhāriṇī devī sarvadā parirakṣatip.12) sarvadānandahṛdaye mahājñānaṃ dine dinesākāreṇa maheśāni nirākārañca bhāvayetsākāre mūlakaṃ sarvaṃ sākārañca prapaśyatinirākāraṃ samāsādya nirañjanapadaṃ labhetevaṃ sarvātmanā devi kāmarūpo na saṃśayaḥdevatādhyānamātreṇa devatābhāvamālabhetvāsanābhāvarūpeṇa manasāyat pratiṣṭhitamhṛdayeśa mahādeva parameśa purātana
